title: QMS Platform: Representation Diagnostics and Real-Measurement Validation
description: QMS Platform v0.3.1 extends the quantum measurement observability and reconstruction-assurance framework with representation diagnostics and expanded real-measurement validation. The release includes QMS-REP-001 through QMS-REP-004 and QMS-REAL-001 through QMS-REAL-025, with validation on superconducting-qubit IQ measurements and raw Glasgow single-photon detector acquisitions. Across four Glasgow conditions spanning heralded/ghost and diffraction/imaging experiments, unchanged distribution-level convergence and state-classification logic transfers without dataset-specific retuning. Negative causal-drift experiments are retained explicitly; prospective causal early-warning capability, universal detector-health calibration, universal drift timing, universal representation geometry, and cross-laboratory transfer are not established.
